notes: Hotels inherit every unspecified inheritable signal from their parent city, and the city from country:AE. Only attributes that DIFFER from the city baseline need to be present. price_inr_per_night is domain data, not a signal — cost_efficiency/value_for_money signals read avg_daily_cost_per_pax_inr / value_index_0_100 instead so hotel cost compares on the same footing as activities and daily budget. Hotels are deliberately thin in UAE v1: the engine defers hotel choice until city and dates are fixed, so this is a representative class-per-city set, not a bookable inventory.
